description: sub, super, middle, text-top and text-bottom move a span against the baseline.

florui.css: .p { width: 280px; background-color: #e8ecff; color: #112233; } .a { vertical-align: sub; font-size: 12px; } .b { vertical-align: super; font-size: 12px; } .c { vertical-align: middle; font-size: 12px; } .d { vertical-align: text-top; font-size: 12px; } .e { vertical-align: text-bottom; font-size: 12px; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 4.67% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Without the feature the same fixture measures 11.41% and the box is 5.5px off, so it fails.
